sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Indian e-commerce sources to query. Each source is isolated; blocked sources are skipped without failing the full run.

searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: Product keywords to search, such as milk, kurti, iphone case, or wireless earbuds.

city.title: City / location name
city.description: Used for location-aware sources such as BigBasket, Blinkit, and JioMart.

brands.title: Brand filter
brands.description: Optional exact brand filters. Leave empty to keep all brands.

inStockOnly.title: In-stock only
inStockOnly.description: Keep only products clearly marked as in stock.

maxResults.title: Maximum product records
maxResults.description: Maximum clean product records to save across all selected sources.

maxPagesPerQuery.title: Maximum pages per query
maxPagesPerQuery.description: Limits pagination or scroll payloads per source/query.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings. Start without a proxy for Myntra; use an India residential proxy if a selected marketplace blocks or localizes requests.
